scope: Editorial length display conventions for eight current families and the strictly segmented Gulf Stream System. No scientific measurements or aliases are admitted.
family_rule: Select the longest positive nominal length among the explicitly listed catalogued basin members; retain every member and its method, scope and time convention. This is a principal-member display length, not a continuous cross-basin current, an aggregate or a measured family maximum.
inventory_limits: Only admitted basin identities participate. Indian NEC naming remains held under research/equatorial-basin-identity-source-review-v1.json and is not silently aliased to Monsoon. Pacific Tsuchiya jets are not silently equated with the Atlantic/Indian SEUC family. Broader and narrower countercurrent families can share members; never sum family rows and their children into a global network length.

conventions.scope_note: Generic eastward equatorial-countercurrent family across admitted Atlantic, Pacific and Indian basin usages. The principal-member number is not the sum of north and south countercurrent families.
Equatorial subsurface EUC basin usages; surface Wyrtki jets and off-equatorial undercurrents excluded.
Admitted Atlantic/Pacific westward NEC members. Seasonal Indian nomenclature remains unresolved and is not assigned a separate member or copied from Monsoon.
Atlantic/Pacific surface NECC members; Indian southern-hemisphere countercurrent is not treated as a north-equatorial member.
Atlantic/Pacific off-equatorial NEUC usages. Pacific member itself uses a declared southern principal jet; its conditional endpoint interpretation propagates to this family display.
Admitted Atlantic/Pacific/Indian westward SEC basin members; parallel branches and return currents are not summed.
Admitted Atlantic/Pacific/Indian SECC usages, with distinct phase/depth contexts retained. No simultaneous global axis implied.
Admitted Atlantic/Indian SEUC usages. Pacific South Subsurface Countercurrent remains a distinct identity and is not silently substituted.

Strict NOAA/textbook sequence: Florida Current from Florida Straits to Cape Hatteras, Gulf Stream proper from Cape Hatteras toward Grand Banks, North Atlantic Current from Grand Banks toward western British Isles. Shared handoff points have zero length; no common along-route segment is summed twice. Excludes Loop/Caribbean upstream, Norwegian and other branches downstream, and recirculations. Combines rounded reported descriptions and one geographic reference-route estimate; it is not a traced continuous axis.
conventions.source_locator: NOAA Gulf Stream System, Florida Current, Gulf Stream and North Atlantic Current glossary entries; Tomczak/Godfrey segment descriptions retained in live measurements. No broader Florida-Straits-to-Atlantic Gulf Stream value is added.
